prOriginal.nota: Found via gh pr list search on the title (branch is-37428-add-html-sanitizer-for-messages). The PR's single commit is the benchmark head 02f48f77; merged as 5d77e7ea on main, same content.

add-html-sanitizer-for-translated-messag.reason: On main today account/messages/messages_lt.properties still has totpStep1=Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare: and login/messages/messages_lt.properties still has the same Italian loginTotpStep1. No later change restored Lithuanian text.

messages_zh_CN.properties was renamed to messages_zh_Hans.properties in d2e9b09e (2025-07-28, 'Migrate to zh-Hant / zh-Hans'), but totpStep1 there still reads 在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一 (Traditional forms) while totpStep2/3 are Simplified. The rename kept the value unchanged.

Commit 3e0bb6df 'Fix range error when minimizing the string' (PR #38779, closes #38778) changed the suffix loop bounds from end < sanitized.length() && end < value.length() to end < sanitized.length() - start && end < value.length() - start, so prefix and suffix can no longer overlap and substring cannot throw. Today's VerifyMessageProperties keeps that bound.

normalizeValue on main still does value.replaceAll("\\{[0-9]+,choice,[^}]*}", "...") for keys starting with linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit and for error-invalid-multivalued-size, before santizeAnchors and the HTML policy run. Markup inside those choice branches is still never checked.

Commit 2b245059 'Don't use Java's MessageFormat for messages evaluated in the front end' (PR #38144, closes #38143) touched exactly the account-ui and admin-ui messages_en.properties; today both have error-invalid-multivalued-size=Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s). The verifier also now rejects single-brace placeholders for frontend bundles (verifyNotMessageFormatPlaceholders).

verifySafeHtml on main still derives the English file by string replacement and wraps the FileInputStream IOException in new RuntimeException("unable to read file " + englishFile). verify() catches only IOException and ThemeVerifierMojo.execute does not catch it, so a bundle without an English sibling still aborts the mojo with an unchecked exception.
